lines.1: By the next day, the rain had cleared completely.
lines.2: 「Hey, Crab. What do you think of this outfit?」
lines.3: 「Ugh, no taste at all. If you wore that on a date, I'd turn around and leave without a word.」
lines.4: 「What!? I wouldn't care if you left... So what would look good, then?」
lines.5: 「Hmm, how about this? It might make that slightly plain face of yours look a little better.」
lines.7: 「...Oh. Now that I've tried it on, this is pretty good.」
lines.8: 「See? The clerk recommended it, too. Being brutally honest is her whole thing. She'll tell you flat-out when something doesn't suit you.」
lines.13: Ever since we were kids, Crab had looked at my clothes and I had looked at hers, and we shopped by giving each other advice.
lines.14: Neither of us held back in the slightest.
lines.15: Listening to Crab annoyed me, but the opposite sex's opinion mattered.
lines.16: I was grateful we could find plenty of good things here without going all the way to Yokohama.
lines.18: 「We bought a lot. Let's get something to eat before we go home. Your treat, obviously.」
lines.20: 「Wandering around alone again... What does she even do out here?」
lines.24: 「Exactly. She's as tough as she looks, so quit worrying over nothing.」
lines.26: --Once again, I walked the city streets at night.
lines.27: I sat down on my favorite bench.
lines.28: I could hear the usual street musician playing.
lines.29: I was beginning to feel comfortable here.
lines.30: I might as well stay until around the time that boy usually went home.
lines.33: What if those guys from before were looking for her?
lines.34: She had probably never been hurt before, so she wouldn't know
lines.35: that nothing was more dangerous than a group of people.
lines.36: But if I warned her, she'd just call me annoying and leave it at that.
lines.38: 「Whoa! Don't suddenly fill my whole field of view!」
lines.39: 「You say you don't want to get swept up in the excitement, but in the end you always do.」
lines.40: 「Shut up. Where did that come from?」
lines.41: 「Still, I think that's one of your cute points.」
lines.42: 「Hmph. I don't need that kind of cuteness. I'll throw it away.」
lines.43: 「Impossible. Your body moves on its own. You're simple-minded in the end.」
lines.45: An idiot had called me simple-minded.
lines.47: I would cry myself to sleep tonight.
lines.50: 「Studying on such a beautiful day is a waste.」
lines.51: 「Don't worry. I will train with you afterward.」
lines.52: 「This is to spare you humiliation on your final exams. Endure it.」
lines.53: 「Hey, don't I deserve a reward if I get a problem right?」
lines.55: 「I-I'll stop complaining and get to work, sir!」
lines.57: She did pat me on the head after I worked hard.
